title: Mansikkakakku kylmänä (Strawberry Layer Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, egg whites, and whipped cream.
steps: Rub 1 cup of sugar with 1/2 cup of butter until creamy.

Add 1/2 cup milk, 1 1/2 to 2 cups flour, 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar, and 1/4 teaspoon soda (cream of tartar and soda dissolved in milk).

title: Marmori Kakku (Marble Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, vanilla or lemon juice, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon juice

steps: For white part: Rub ½ cupful of butter and 1 cupful of sugar to a cream, add 4 well-beaten yolks of eggs, ½ cupful of milk, 2 teaspoonfuls of baking powder mixed with 2 cupfuls of flour and 1 teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon juice. Lastly stir the stiffly beaten whites of eggs into the mixture. If white batter is preferred, leave out the yolks of eggs.

For dark part: Work ½ cupful of butter and 1 cupful of brown sugar to a cream, add well-beaten yolks of eggs, ½ cupfuls of molasses, ½ cupful of milk, 1 teaspoonful of soda, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg, ½ teaspoonful of each, and 2 cupfuls of flour; lastly whites, beaten to a froth. Or use for the dark part the same mixture as for the white part mixed with 1½ ozs. of melted chocolate.
Butter a mold and lay a spoonful of both mixtures alternately in it to resemble marble.
Bake in a buttered mold in a moderate oven.

title: Mock Turtle Soup
description: A soup made with calf's head, onion, and carrot.

ingredients.name: 1 cupful of stewed and strained tomatoes

steps: Clean and wash the split calf's head.
Place it into boiling water and cook until tender with vegetables salt and pepper.
Remove the head from the kettle.
Take the bones out of it and put them to boil again.
Cut the meat and the tongue, removing the skin from it, into nice pieces — only nice pieces may be used — and warm them in a small quantity of strained stock.
Chop the onion, brown in butter, add flour, meat stock and the stock of calf's head into it and let it boil up.
Add tomatoes and the cut meat.
Season with cayenne and color with Kitchen Bouquet.

description: A soup made with bouillon or water or milk, potatoes, and celery.

title: Perunoita maitokastikkeen kanssa (Creamed Potatoes)
description: Prepared with potatoes, butter, and flour.

ingredients.name: new potatoes or cold boiled potatoes

steps: Cut new potatoes into dice or boil whole potatoes in salted water until done.
Drain and cover with milk sauce made of 2 tablespoons of butter, 2 tablespoons of flour and 1 pint of scalded milk.
Season with salt, pepper and parsley.
If cold boiled potatoes are used, cut the potatoes in pieces and boil slowly in rich milk.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter, salt and pepper and just before serving sprinkle with minced parsley.

Alternatively, bake potatoes in a buttered mold sprinkled with bread crumbs and grated cheese, using half the amount of flour in the sauce, covering until potatoes are nearly done (about 40 minutes), then remove cover, sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs or 2 beaten eggs on top, and bake until browned.

title: Pickled Apples
description: Prepared with apples, vinegar, and sugar.
steps: Pare the apples, place into a jar alternate layers of apples and sugar
Pour water and vinegar over
Let stand covered overnight
Drain the juice, put into a kettle with the spices tied in a bag
When the juice is coming to a boil and looks clear, add the apples
Cook until nearly done
Place the apples into glass jars, pour the boiling hot juice over
Cover airtight

title: Pickled Onions (Suomalais-Amerikalainen)
description: Prepared with onions, vinegar, and white pepper.

ingredients.name: a handful of salt to a quart of boiling water

steps: Wash onions, pour boiling water on and peel when water gets cool
Prepare a brine allowing a handful of salt to a quart of boiling water
Cover the onions with the brine
Let stand for 24 hours
Boil 10 minutes vinegar, sugar and spices, wrapped in a linen cloth
Remove the spices, place the onions in and let cook nearly tender
Put the onions in jar, drain the vinegar on, cork and keep in a cool place

title: Pig's Head
description: Prepared with pork, sherry, and carrots.
steps: Split the head, remove the tongue, saw the bone leaving the nose whole.
Grind all kinds of pork, pound well.
Mix with 4 eggs, pepper, salt and sherry.
Put one half of the pork forcemeat into the head, lay on it slices of carrots, truffles, cucumbers, etc.
Fill with the remaining forcemeat.
Sew up the head and the eyes.
Put a slice of carrot in the ears and fasten them down.
Tie the nose with cord.
Wrap the head in a cloth and cook.
Place under a heavy weight.
Serve cold with Cumberland sauce.
